verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs say results depend on whether you use its Bayesian or Frequentist engine and explain metrics such as Chance to Win. The GitHub README lists CUPED and post-stratification for variance reduction, plus sequential testing and SRM checks. Community comments question early-stopping detail but do not contradict the engine's existence. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of CUPED/post-stratification configuration and methodology, independent or hands-on corroboration of the stats engine's correctness.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results
